faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: How does the free trial work?
faq.a1: You get a 14-day free trial with no commitment. No credit card required to get started.
faq.q2: Can I change plans at any time?
faq.a2: Yes, you can upgrade or downgrade your plan at any time. The change takes effect immediately.
faq.q3: What payment methods do you accept?
faq.a3: We accept credit cards (Visa, Mastercard, American Express) through Stripe, our secure payment processor.
faq.a4: Send us an email at support@yourdomain.com. We respond within 24 hours on business days.
